title.zh: v2.0.49 钢琴卷帘单轨试听与和弦试听根因修复、鼓组/合成音质一揽子修复、159 曲风按大类分档响度对齐
title.en: v2.0.49 Piano-roll Lane Preview & Chord Audition Root-cause Fix, Drum/Synth Fidelity Pass, Per-category Loudness Alignment for All 159 Genres

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘试听和弦的根因修复**：试听和弦进行时逐音触发，而和弦轨的引擎会为传进来的每个单音再配一副和弦——4 个音实际发出 12 个声部（24 个振荡器）。新增 `previewChord()` 一次播放整副已完成声部，并让试听与“写入进行”共用同一份音符计算函数，从结构上杜绝“试听到的和写入的不是一回事”。
highlights.en: **Chord audition root cause fixed**: the progression audition fired one call per chord member, and the engine re-voices whatever single note a chords track is handed — so a four-note chord produced twelve voices (24 oscillators). A new `previewChord()` plays the finished voicing in one call, and audition now shares one note-calculation function with the stamp, so preview and result cannot disagree.

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘可单独播放当前谱子**：新增按轨隔离预览（只发被预览轨、按小节范围循环、复用走带与播放头），且不修改全局静音/独奏状态；卷帘内新增“试听本轨 / 停止 + 范围”控件，关闭卷帘自动停止。
highlights.en: **Play just the current lane in the piano roll**: an isolated per-track preview (only the previewed track sounds, loops within a bar range, reuses the existing transport and playhead) that never touches global mute/solo state. New in-roll Play lane / Stop + Range controls; closing the roll stops it.

highlights.zh: **鼓组一揽子音质修复**：开镲 choke 由阶跃改为解析式包络锚点平滑淡出（消除每次闭镲的咔哒）；51 个曲风声明的 clap/rimshot 军鼓此前被忽略、现按声明发声；选择底鼓预设不再连带换掉整套鼓；鼓音高轨整体移调（原先只移扫频起点导致落地跑调）；非 808 套件踩镲补上金属簇（此前是纯噪声）；开镲恢复镲片长度；拍手各次爆发读取不同噪声切片；底鼓补齐饱和级；`kick:*` 预设接上力度→音色。
highlights.en: **Drum fidelity pass**: open-hat choke is now an analytic-envelope fade instead of a step (no click on every close); the clap/rimshot snare declared by 51 genres is finally voiced as declared; picking a kick preset no longer re-voices the whole kit; the drum pitch lane transposes the whole voice (it used to move only the sweep start, leaving the tail detuned); non-808 hats gain a metal cluster (they were pure noise); open hats ring like cymbals; clap bursts read different no…
